requirements.EXP-TXT-001: A placeholder, a name in braces, is replaced by the text of its value, once, left to right; a name the chart does not have is left as written; nothing in a template or a value is evaluated, so code-like text (`${…}`, `<script>`, `{{…}}`) is text.
requirements.EXP-TXT-002: Every chart takes `title`, `subtitle` and `footnotes`, null by default; a title or subtitle that is not text, or footnotes that are not text or a list of texts, are refused with a sentence naming the setting.
requirements.EXP-TXT-003: In the page, a title, subtitle or footnote holding code-like text is drawn as that text: no element is made of it, no script runs, and a placeholder inside it is filled as text.
requirements.EXP-AUTO-001: The chart's own footnote, always last, gives the date drawn (UTC), the bio.viz version, and for each statistic printed R's method and the counts R used, with which R computed it: R in this browser, or a stored result with its R and gsm.bio versions; while R is asked it says it is waiting, and it says when nothing was asked, when statistics are unavailable and when R reported an error.
requirements.EXP-AUTO-002: A connection given `computedBy`, which R computed its stored results, hands that record with every stored answer and with no other; a record that is not one is refused with a sentence.
requirements.EXP-AUTO-003: In the page the chart's own footnote says it is waiting while R is asked, and is written again when R answers; with no R it says statistics are unavailable, and a view that asks R nothing says so.
requirements.EXP-DRAW-001: The group comparison draws its title and subtitle above it and its footnotes under it, every placeholder filled from the view drawn, with its own footnote last naming the date, the version, R's method and counts and the R and gsm.bio versions of the stored result; it holds at 390px.
requirements.EXP-DRAW-002: The same for the association scatter.
requirements.EXP-DRAW-003: The same for the correlation matrix.
requirements.EXP-DRAW-004: The same for the biomarker screen.
requirements.EXP-DRAW-006: The same for the stratified survival chart.
requirements.EXP-SITE-001: Each chart's demo on the gallery shows its title, subtitle and footnotes, every placeholder filled, with the chart's own footnote last; at 390px the page does not scroll sideways.
requirements.EXP-CSV-001: A CSV is written by RFC 4180: records end in CRLF; a field or a heading holding a comma, a double quote, a carriage return or a line feed is quoted, each double quote doubled; it reads back field for field, and a number reads back as itself.
requirements.EXP-CSV-002: The statistics are R's answer laid out as a table: a row for each answer's result and one for each of its parts, every member R returned a column and every number R's own, with the R function asked and the data it was asked about; an answer R did not give has no rows.
requirements.EXP-PNG-001: A downloaded PNG carries its resolution as pixels per metre (`pHYs`) and, as UTF-8 text (`iTXt`), its title, its description (the footnotes) and the software that made it with its version (`bio.viz 0.2.0`), and no other text, each chunk with its CRC, after the header.
requirements.EXP-DL-001: The group comparison downloads a PNG of its frame at `png_scale` times its width on the page, its title and footnotes in the file; the statistics R returned as CSV, every number R's; and the table it drew from as CSV, its rows and columns; a heading with a comma reads back as one heading; each file is named for the chart and the view.
requirements.EXP-DL-002: The same for the association scatter.
requirements.EXP-DL-003: The same for the correlation matrix.
requirements.EXP-DL-004: The same for the biomarker screen.
requirements.EXP-DL-006: The same for the stratified survival chart.
requirements.EXP-DL-007: Every chart takes `downloads`, true by default, and `png_scale`, 2 by default, from 1 to 4, and refuses anything else with a sentence; with `downloads` false the bar is not shown, `png_scale` sets the picture's size and resolution, and the statistics download waits for an answer from R and is not offered by a view that asks R nothing.
requirements.EXP-AUTO-004: The chart's own footnote names every method R used for what is printed, the pairwise test beside the overall one, and every adjustment of the p-values, by name.
requirements.EXP-AUTO-005: The footnote never names a released version for code that is not one: a build with changes since its release says `with development changes`; package.json's `bioviz.development` is true exactly while the release log has an upcoming section, and false in a tagged build.
requirements.EXP-AUTO-006: Counts are named for four groups and summarised for five or more, numeric text is read as a number, and many counts are summarised without spreading them; the source is the connection's form as it says, and a stored result's date is named.
requirements.EXP-TXT-004: A title or subtitle of only white space is absent; a chart whose placeholders throw is still titled and the error is reported; each placeholder's value is a run of its own, drawn in a `<bdi>` so its direction is isolated.
requirements.EXP-TXT-005: In the group comparison's overview, `{n}` is the participants drawn anywhere on its page of biomarkers.
requirements.EXP-UPD-001: The group comparison's title and subtitle are filled again when a filter or a control moves: `{filters}` names the filter, `{n}` counts the participants it lets through, and the control's placeholder reads its new value.
requirements.EXP-UPD-002: The same for the association scatter.
requirements.EXP-UPD-003: The same for the correlation matrix.
requirements.EXP-UPD-004: The same for the biomarker screen.
requirements.EXP-UPD-006: The same for the stratified survival chart.
requirements.EXP-PNG-002: On a wide page and on a phone, the PNG draws the marks the chart draws, each where the page has it: every disc of the correlation matrix and its colour key, and the screen's zero line, intervals and dots.
requirements.EXP-PNG-003: On a phone, what scrolls sideways in the frame is drawn whole, the survival chart's at-risk table to its last column, and the picture is as wide as it needs.
requirements.EXP-PNG-004: Every control of a chart's frame (the toolbar, the hint, the listing, the bar of downloads, a chart's own download and pager buttons) is marked `bv-no-picture`, which the picture leaves out.
requirements.EXP-DL-008: A download that fails says so in the bar, in a line a screen reader announces; the next download works and takes the line away.
requirements.EXP-DL-009: The table download holds the value a cut was made from: the survival chart's biomarker beside its group, and the cross-tabulation's for a cut row or column.
requirements.EXP-DL-010: In the group comparison's overview, Table downloads every value drawn on its page of biomarkers, one row per participant, biomarker and visit, with each group; the overview offers the PNG and the table, and no statistics, since it asks R nothing.
requirements.EXP-CSV-003: Every member R returned is a column, however nested: lists of objects or of lists in the data asked about are flattened by place, nested names are joined by a slash, and a member that would take an identifying column's name, or two written alike, is refused.
requirements.EXP-CSV-004: NaN, Inf and -Inf are written as R writes them, apart from a value missing; a list of values is joined by ` | `.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-001: A specification names its format, its format version, the bio.viz version, the chart, every setting that is data and every filter in force as a column, an operator and values; the page's connection and way back, and anything that is not data, are not written.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-002: Nothing in a specification is evaluated: code-like text in a setting or a filter is read as that text; a function, a number JSON cannot hold, undefined or an object that is not plain is refused with a sentence that says where it is; a key reaching an object's prototype is no setting.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-003: A specification is refused with a sentence naming what is wrong when it is not one, is of another format version, names a chart bio.viz does not have, holds a setting the chart does not have in this version, or a filter whose operator is not `in`; one written by another version is read when its settings are still settings; a filter in force is laid onto the chart's filters as where it starts.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-004: The format has a JSON schema, committed as `src/data/specification.schema.json` and written from each chart's own settings; `npm test` fails when it is stale; it holds a written specification and refuses an unknown chart, an unknown setting of a chart, an unknown operator and an unknown member.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-005: The group comparison writes its specification, held by the schema, as its controls and filters now read; made again from it by `BioViz.fromSpecification`, the chart draws the same view, asks R the same and writes the same specification.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-006: The same for the association scatter.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-007: The same for the correlation matrix.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-008: The same for the biomarker screen.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-010: The same for the stratified survival chart.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-011: In the page, a chart made from a specification holding code-like text draws it as text and runs nothing; one with a setting the chart does not have, or an operator that is not `in`, is refused with a sentence and makes no chart.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-012: The site publishes the format's schema at `schema/specification.json`, the committed file.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-013: A selection emptied by hand round-trips: every Visit of the group comparison and every biomarker of the correlation matrix unticked write `[]`, which the reader takes, and the chart made again draws the same nothing.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-014: A filter of several values emptied by hand writes `values: []` and comes back empty, letting nobody through.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-015: What a specification asks for that the data cannot draw is said above the chart and listed in `chart.notices`: a filter on a column the participant table lacks, a value a filter does not offer, a grouping the tables lack, a filter on the id column; a filter named twice is refused.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-016: A specification opens on the same page of the group comparison's overview and of the screen, in the screen's order, and the survival chart's Groups keep the cut it opened on after a moved line.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-017: Reading a specification makes every check making the chart makes: a value the chart refuses is refused with the chart's sentence, and an empty selection the chart can draw is read.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-018: An object given as a specification is read once, own data properties only: a getter or a setter is refused, a Proxy's traps run once each and only the copy is checked, and nesting deeper than 64 is refused.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-019: `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype` are no column: a filter on one, or a setting naming one, is refused by the reader and the schema.
requirements.EXP-SPEC-020: The reader and the schema agree: `bio_viz_version` is text, a filter names a column once and each value once, a column's name is not blank, `settings.filters` is a list or null; the schema gives every setting's default and is written from the one chart list.
requirements.EXP-SITE-002: Every chart's picture in the gallery is a capture of its frame taken by `captureGallery`, which fails rather than capture when the frame lacks its title or its own footnote, or when R has not answered.
requirements.EXP-SITE-003: The built gallery shows every chart in that picture, its title and footnotes drawn in, and at 390px the page does not scroll sideways.
